entries.title: Consent banner flow.
entries.notes: Capture in a fresh browser context with no capell_insights_consent localStorage entry and no capell_insights_visit cookie, with consent_banner_enabled=true and a policy version that has not been stored locally. The capture must show the packaged consent banner, not a plain demo page.
